column1: # Registry of quantified claims about the muon-cost ledger. Produced by the enumerator in
# tests/test_ledger_claims.py; see test_quantified_claims_registered for its exact definition.
# status is EXERCISED:<test node id> | REGISTERED:<reason> | UNREVIEWED.
# EXERCISED means a named test fails when the claim is negated -- not that a test merely mentions it.
# REGISTERED means the claim was read and judged by a person; the note says what was checked to
# rule it, specific to that line. Early rows carry a review-category note instead, which is the
# weaker form: a reason repeated across rows names no check and was registered as a defect.
# UNREVIEWED is for claims that predate the cost-basis work; their count is capped by the
# monotone non-increasing LEDGER_CLAIMS_UNREVIEWED_CEILING and may only ever go down.
